title: Pentagon Warns Prediction Market Bets Endanger Troops
excerpt: A Pentagon memo warns that insider trading on prediction markets gives adversaries key intelligence and puts military operations at risk.
body_html:
A recent Pentagon memo warns that wagers placed on prediction markets regarding military operations can distort military judgment and place troops in danger.

According to the memo, insider trading within these prediction platforms can provide foreign adversaries with critical intelligence regarding sensitive operations. Officials noted that these activities create serious security risks by potentially revealing strategic movements and decisions to external actors.

The warning highlights growing concerns over how modern financial and prediction platforms intersect with national security and sensitive defense operations.
